technical-summary: v2 manifest plan_cache_key now covers the engine tuning settings (when present) and every rank's card in a mixed-architecture world, matching the native plan key fixed in #959; single-card and tuning-free configurations keep their keys, so stored live-policy calibration records (flashnext-4gpu, flashnext-2xtx-rdna2-tail) still match.
user-summary-candidate: A changed TP split or other tuning setting is no longer treated as the same memory plan by the v2 manifest key.
